verdict.summary: The documentation-only reconciliation remains internally coherent and appropriately caveated as research-grade, externally unaudited, and gated by sq-qhy4. The amended authority map and binding contract agree with the frozen CRDT specification on JCS canonicalization, rejection of non-canonical or wrong-membership-epoch envelopes, quad identity, and rejection of COPY/MOVE/ADD. The cited shipped E2EE primitives also support the narrower corroborating claims about u64 epochs, randomized sealing, and history-policy tokens. The new banners consistently mark superseded clauses without claiming implementation or cryptographic proof, and the ReplicaId linkability discussion is framed as a disclosed authorized-reader risk rather than a proved privacy property. No reviewer-directed instruction or other prompt injection was detected in the diff.
